【 Why Choose the kingphenix Mesh Lumbar Support Cushion?】
kingphenix chair back support cushion is designed for drivers, white-collar workers and other sedentary people. The lumbar cushion can be adjusted to fit your lumbar, correct your sitting posture and relieve back pain

【 6 Details Guaranty the Quality】
★ Ergonomic design
★ Adjustable elastic belt
★ Effectively fit your lumbar
★ Breathable mesh design
★ Suitable for most seats
★ Four seasons general

【 High Quality Materials】
The carefully selected breathable mesh fabrics ensure the comfortable fit and wear-resistant. The sturdy steel frame makes it not easy to be deformed

【 Exquisite Workmanship】
The wear-resistant edging design reflects kingphenix's exquisite workmanship and effectively extends the service life of the car lumbar support cushion

【 Easy to Clean】
Adopts lightweight design for easy installation and removal. This seat lumbar support is easy to clean, it is recommended to dry after hand washing

【 Wonderful Gift】
The adjustable back cushion for office chair is the great gift for Christmas, Valentine’s Day, Birthday, protecting the lumbar health of you and your family

★★★★★【 After Sales Service】★★★★★
You will get 100% customer support and quality assurance of this lumbar support for car. If you have any questions of back cushion, please contact us

【 Specifications】
Materials......Breathable fabric + steel
Dimensions......15.7*15.5*5.3 inches
Adjustable height.......5.3-7 inches
Weight......1.21 lbs

【 Package Includes】
2 * Seat lumbar supports pillow

items.label: Ergonomic Design
items.value: With ergonomic design, the lumbar support can help you correct your sitting posture, effectively support your lumbar to relieve the discomfort of driving or sitting for long time

items.label: Upgraded Version
items.value: The upgrade lumbar support for car use high-elastic straps to adjust the radian from 5.3 to 7 inches, which can fit your lumbar better

items.label: Comfort and Breathable
items.value: The mesh car back support use breathable double-layer mesh, keep your back and waist cool and dry effectively

items.label: Wide Applicability
items.value: With the install belt, the lumbar support for chair is very easy to install. Suit for 99% seats, such as car, home, school, office seats, etc

items.label: After-Sales Service
items.value: You will get customer support and quality assurance of this lumbar back support cushion. For the better shopping experience, we will help you if any questions until you are satisfied

items.label: Manufacturer Warranty Description
items.value: Manufacturer warranty for 1years form date of purchase
